summary: Correct PR #37's blind-routing evidence claim: classify WA-EVAL-031..033 as repository-visible regression cases, bind strict RP probe context to exact Git revision and a hashed bundle manifest/identity, preserve pre-oracle raw-response capture, and keep semantic grading/psychological freshness as separate review claims.

requirements.rationale: The operationalization snapshot maps current real-use gaps to existing Requirements without changing Requirement text, criticality or authority. Future activation may re-evaluate whether refinement is needed.

issues_findings.rationale: Focused evidence review confirmed the routing mechanism/referential fidelity and exposed a test-validity distinction: WA-EVAL-031..033 are prompt-blind but repository-visible and therefore regression-only for this claim. Strict evidence uses the existing stimulus-only RP probe path, now hardened so accessible context is read from the exact Git revision and the captured response is bound to a hashed bundle manifest/identity.

risks.rationale: The correction reduces false-assurance risk by separating prompt blindness from repository blindness and by binding the trial to exact Git-derived context. Remaining uncertainty is behavioral/semantic: the RP probes have not yet been independently executed and no oracle has been persisted.

decisions_concepts.rationale: WA-EVAL-031..033 remain visible regression cases only. Independent behavioral evidence must use stimulus-only opaque probes delivered through an isolated exact-revision operational bundle, with probe identifiers kept out of the accessible operational context and raw response persisted before oracle reveal. OH-03 remains a compatible open system-function hypothesis, not the preferred interpretation. No new Building Block, registry, authority class, priority or implementation authority is created.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh derived current-state reconciliation provenance only; programme counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: PR #37 remains review/evidence work and is not yet a Promotion Candidate. P2 remains independently blocked on explicit Human implementation admission with implementation_allowed=false.

active_work.rationale: No OC or P2 implementation is activated. The evidence-control correction is systemically reconciled. Independent RP probe execution, later oracle reveal/grading and qualitative review remain separate promotion-readiness evidence gates.
